meta.description: IQ2GQ Hub - matched syndicate Super Rugby picks against real-world match results and bookmaker odds
meta.source_odds_data: aussportsbetting.com Historical Super Rugby Results and Odds Data (personal use only, not for redistribution - derived/matched data only)
meta.matching_method: Team name canonicalisation (incl. ACT Brumbies/NSW Warratahs/Melbourne Rebels/Queensland Reds/Western Force shorthand, Fiji Drua word-order variants, and Half-time/Full-time bet formatting artifacts) + nearest-date match within +/-8 days of the recorded pick date. Covers all Super Rugby era/branding variants (Aotearoa, Australia, Transtasman, Pacific, main competition, South Africa) as one continuous dataset, since the underlying real games are identical regardless of what the syndicate's Sport field called that season.
meta.excluded_rows_note: 9 rows excluded entirely: Sport tagged 'Rugby Union (Super Rugby Aupiki)', the separate WOMEN'S competition, for which this file (men's competition only) has no corresponding data. 9 further rows excluded for Sport field mistagging (NRL teams, an English Gallagher Premiership club, and an international team, all mistagged as Super Rugby). 1 row excluded as a player-only prop pick (no single team stated). 1 row (Key 3150, Sharks, Oct 2020) excluded as unmatched: South African teams' 2020 season ended in March due to COVID border closures and they did not participate in the later Aotearoa/Australia/Transtasman bubble tournaments, so no real game exists near that date.

picks.bet_type: First Half Winning margin 15 or more
